source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action export in context internal; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role guest or admin, except for action export; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80. Action inspect in context internal prefers review at priority 70. Role admin or context partner prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk TRUE, or action export in context internal; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means role guest or admin, except for action export; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80.
Action inspect in context internal prefers review at priority 70.
Role admin or context partner prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == export) and (event.context == internal))

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == guest) or (event.role == admin)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == internal)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action != export)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule InspectInternal:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule TrustedForbidAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule AdminOrPartner:
    when (event.role == admin) or (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule DefaultDeny:
    when (event.role == guest) or (event.role != guest)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1
